/home/labdrian/memorycard/internal/memory/save.go and import.go: HardCapBytes is 64 KB. A larger body is split into parts, and part 1 keeps the topic key. Parts 2 and up get the key <key>/part-N and the title '(part i/N)'. savedPartCount re-saves a split manifest correctly. This matches contract rule 6, the 64 KB chunk rule and the resume rule.

longterm-mem/internal/mcpserver/server.go: promote takes a source of engram or memorycard, with the memorycard id in engram_id. The query tool has a sources list that accepts 'vault'. Both match the new SKILL.md wording.

longterm-mem/internal/ingest/header.go ParseHeader: manifest content that starts with '---' and has no later '\n---\n' is accepted through the HasPrefix branch. The re-ingestion gate can therefore read Source-SHA256 and Status from a provenance-first manifest.

longterm-mem/internal/ingest/extract.go buildSource: a manifest's Content is manifest.Render() alone, with no body. This already matches the new 'provenance block first' text. Chunks are Text plus the block, so the block stays last for them.
Splitting by memorycard cannot break the ingest code: DefaultMaxChunkBytes is 1600, MaxChunks is 9999, and a manifest passes 64 KB only for a source of roughly 2,600 or more chunks.
